title: Debiasing should be Good and Bad: Measuring the Consistency of Debiasing Techniques in Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on debiasing LMs from "toxic or inappropriate text" and ensuring the consistency of debiasing methods. While it mentions "ethical AI systems" and has an "Ethics Statement," these do not constitute a core component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics within the LM's generated content itself. The evaluation criteria revolve around "Specification Polarity, Specification Importance, and Domain Transferability" concerning toxicity, sexual explicitness, and profanity, which falls under general undesirable behavior rather than specific ethical frameworks or religious content.
